demo page over real site index
ui-test the keyboard flow at 400/1280, zero console errors at 4 widths

assign.now: ui-test proving the keyboard flow at 400/1280/1920/3440

log.msg: index build measured live in-browser: 1,056 urls in 9.6ms (fetch+parse of /directory.json, no crawl, no server)

ui-test: open with /, type cor, ArrowDown x2, Enter -> url changed to /framework/ui/accordion/ at 400 and 1280; zero console errors at 400/1280/1920/3440; the highlighted row's borrowed preview() rendered live (the real Accordion demo) inside the results panel

ui-test skill finding: drive.mjs's offscreen-x check freezes `vp.width` from the plan's initial viewport and never updates it after a mid-run `viewport` verb resize, so every element past the OLD width false-positives as offscreen post-resize; confirmed false (doc.scrollWidth<=clientWidth, no real overflow) by re-running 3440 as the plan's own starting viewport instead of a mid-run resize

log.msg: found via the same ui-test: toggling command mode off left 3 stale (invisible) rows in the DOM until the next open - draw() now clears $list/$preview on the closed branch too; re-ran the 400/1280 keyboard-flow proof after the fix, still zero console errors, url still changes to /framework/ui/accordion/

assign.outcome:
**A keyboard-first Omnibox lands** — `/` or Ctrl/Cmd+K opens a field that stays visible in the shell even closed, ranks the current topic's subtree before the whole site (an exact-title match still jumps every local guess), and borrows the destination's own `preview()` for whatever is highlighted. Proven live over the real ~1,056-url index.

- [ext/Omnibox docs](/framework/ext/Omnibox/) — the class, the CSS, the readme
- [Demo: over the real site index](/imagine/platform/omnibox/) — three scripted scenarios, bound to the Platform topic
- [Interaction-model verdicts](/framework/ext/Omnibox/doc/decisions/) — the visible-field call, what "strong" means, the Space-bar verdict and the one query it gets wrong

![](shots/1280-arrowdown2-accordion.png)

Index measured live in-browser: **1,056 urls in 9.6ms** — one fetch of `/directory.json`, no crawl, no server. `ui-test` proved open(`/`) → type → arrow ×2 → Enter changes the url at 400 and 1280 (screenshots in `shots/`); zero console errors at 400/1280/1920/3440.

Left out, on purpose: content search inside a page, users, and a real command palette (three hardcoded links, to prove the branch only) — all named on the demo's own "Not now" section. Nothing was cut from the closed list — budget held.
